messages.subject: Loop code for tryallpositions()?
parts:
Hi there,
I have almost 400 markers that I want to test for tryallpositions(). It will just take me huge amount of time if I write code for each marker. I made a datafile with list of all markers I want to test. Can anyone help me with a code that input the list, try all markers one by one using tryallpositions() on my cross object?

Thanks for any help!

Prashant

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Loop code for tryallpositions()?
parts:
If markers is a vector of marker names, I'd do something like:

    output <- vector("list", length(markers))
    names(output) <- markers
    for(i in seq_along(markers)) {
        output[[i]] <- tryallpositions(mycross, markers[i])
    }

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: Loop code for tryallpositions()?
parts:
The results will be contained in the object you create, output.

If you look at the help file for tryallpositions(), you’ll see the default value for maxit.
The estimation of the map uses an iterative algorithm that stops when the change in values is less than the tolerance argument tol, or when maxit iterations have been reached.  The warning says it reached the maximum iterations before the estimates had stabilized.

karl
